submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gives the highest signal efficiency at the allocated 8 kHz in the emulation: 92.3% at 35 GeV, versus 84.9% for Algorithm-L1 and 74.6% for Algorithm-L3 at the same threshold. The 2025 summary numbers were reproduced. I scanned L2 thresholds: 25 GeV gives 88.3%, 30 GeV 90.6%, 35 GeV 92.3%, 38 GeV 90.4%, 40 GeV 89.9%, and 45 GeV 91.4%, so 35 GeV is the best point I found. Deployability: candidate_specs.md states that all three candidates fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), which is the only hardware evidence in the project documents. L2 is an iterative topological clustering, and iterative algorithms can have variable latency that is hard to fit into a fixed Level-1 pipeline. The documents do not address latency, so this is unverified. Before the Q4 firmware freeze, the L2 latency needs to be confirmed. If it cannot be met, Algorithm-L1 (sliding-window, the conventional L1 structure) at 35 GeV is the fallback, with 84.9% efficiency.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
